mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies near Verona Area High School with an air quality index of 53. We are currently under a New Moon, and while the ISS is passing overhead, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 63 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Common Council recently voted to adopt the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, a long-term roadmap created with community input to improve housing, transportation, and sustainability. Additionally, the city continues to maintain its strong Aa1 financial rating from Moody's.

Today features live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can head over to Insight Wellness for yoga, and this coming Monday, don't miss trivia at Hop Haus Brewing or Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a noteworthy call from September 28, officers responded to a collision involving a 16-year-old operating an eMoto recklessly, resulting in multiple traffic citations.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 35 minutes, so be sure to get your scoop before they wrap up for the night.
